topics.title: What energy is and where it comes from
topics.scope: The channel's core concept: energy as a finite resource/currency, its physiology (mitochondria, ATP), norms, the 4 energy types, and the 'battery' metaphor.

topics.title: Biorhythms and energy peaks
topics.scope: Circadian and ultradian rhythms, planning the day around natural energy peaks, morning energy, seasonal changes, famous people's routines.

topics.title: Energy drains, leaks and myths
topics.scope: What steals energy: productivity myths, energy drinks, Zoom fatigue, emotions and thoughts as leaks, procrastination vs low charge.

topics.title: Energy boosters and replenishing practices
topics.scope: Practices and inputs the authors credit with restoring energy: MCT/ghee fats, banya, nature and forest bathing, hiking, floating, birding, daily routines (Huberman, Rick Owens).

topics.title: A year of the energy diary
topics.scope: Katya's longitudinal self-tracking experiment (time diary + energy diary through 2025): quarterly findings, dips and recoveries, final-year insights.

topics.title: Three questions about energy (mini-interviews)
topics.scope: Recurring rubric: guests rate their energy stability and share what drains and restores their resource.

topics.title: Series: I'm 40 and worn out
topics.scope: Katya's 2025-26 essay series on why everyone is so tired: the taboo on rest, generational fatigue, physiology of rest, pseudo-rest, self-tests, 42% for rest.

topics.title: Learning to rest
topics.scope: How to actually rest: rest formula, rest types matched to depleted energy, aftercare, unplugged vacations, retreats, podcast appearances on rest.

topics.title: Burnout: prevention and exit
topics.scope: Burnout mechanics and recovery: red flags, 4 kinds of energy, passion-driven burnout, 'get sick to rest', Katya's own burnout history and experiments.

topics.title: «Отдохнувшие»: the rest laboratory
topics.scope: Katya's closed group and later laboratory for learning to rest: how it works, enrollment, client journeys and testimonials.

topics.title: Sleep as the base
topics.scope: Why sleep is the foundation of energy: deprivation effects (hormones, glucose, appearance), alcohol and light at night, exercise and sleep, sufficiency self-tests, science uncertainty.

topics.title: Sleep practice and gear
topics.scope: Practical sleep hygiene: pillows, light alarms, earplugs, bedtime consistency, fixing broken sleep, revenge bedtime procrastination, the sleep practicum.

topics.title: Sugar, sweets and glucose
topics.scope: How sugar affects energy, calorie quality (Lustig/Hyman), eating sweets without bans and guilt.

topics.title: Nutrition myths and evidence-based guidelines
topics.scope: Gastroenterologist myth-busting (keto, fruit, gluten), Norway's dietary guidelines, oral health as a health pillar, evidence-based eating.

topics.title: Marina's nutrition column
topics.scope: Marina Sidorich's food-for-energy rubric: calcium for women, fiber norms, what's wrong with calorie trackers.

topics.title: Coffee, caffeine and alcohol-free
topics.scope: Caffeine rules and myths, coffee-with-milk glucose experiment, Katya's 6+ alcohol-free years and non-alcoholic wine/beer picks.

topics.title: Everyday food culture
topics.scope: Intuitive eating, healthy-habit checklists, home cooking and recipes, ready-meal delivery, holiday eating, under-eating as a root problem.

topics.title: Fitness independence and sustainable movement
topics.scope: Movement not tied to a gym: motivation, fitness independence steps, workouts never becoming automatic, workout recovery, endurance and career, VR fitness.

topics.title: Minimal effective dose of movement
topics.scope: 7,000 steps, 10-minute workouts, zero-zone/NEAT activity, books that make you love movement (McGonigal, Murakami).

topics.title: Body image, face and beauty
topics.scope: Body neutrality, weight vs health, Zoom dysmorphia, beauty burnout, skincare and puffiness routines, LED masks, Ozempic critique, beauty spending.

topics.title: Eating disorder recovery, weight genetics and body acceptance
topics.scope: Katya's story of an unrecognized eating disorder, the EAT-26 screening test, why genetics and metabolic adaptation make thinness the wrong goal, and how a genetic test led to tailored eating, movement and sleep habits.

topics.title: What is balance (and is it real)
topics.scope: The channel's title question: balance definitions, critiques ('fuck the balance', adaptivity), balance as contrast, dosage, slowing down, psychological equilibrium, freedom.

topics.title: Work-life balance in practice
topics.scope: Combining work, family and life: 8+8+8, calendar rules, agency and rest, misery tax, forwarded takes on work-life balance.

topics.title: Women's fatigue and social expectations
topics.scope: Why women tire more: superwoman expectations, internalized misogyny, beauty burnout, depression in women, war and 'female' values.

topics.title: Relocation and staying stable through moves
topics.scope: How place affects well-being after emigration: why Belgrade suits her better than the US or Europe, and her portable 'rider' of routines (meditation, simple food, home workouts, housing, rituals) that keeps her stable through repeated moves.

topics.title: Emotions as energy
topics.scope: Emotional regulation: Lisa Feldman Barrett's body budget, cognitive reappraisal, embodiment, the three emotion-regulation systems.

topics.title: Meditation and mindfulness
topics.scope: Meditation practices and courses: emotional-energy meditation, happiness course, microdosing mindfulness, Goleman/Davidson, anticipatory suffering, arkhe album.

topics.title: Inner work: self-worth, shame, parts
topics.scope: Self-compassion and the inner critic, self-esteem vs self-worth, the architecture of shame, IFS/self-leadership, self-care psychology and permissions.

topics.title: Digital hygiene and attention
topics.scope: Phone and information diet: morning chats, telegram hygiene, Brick, Kindle instead of phone, focus habits, unsubscribing.

topics.title: Impermanence, uncertainty and resilience
topics.scope: Living with things outside your control: impermanence and the two-arrows practice after a visa refusal, scenario thinking instead of predicting the future, and a six-step approach to chronic fatigue and anxiety in wartime.

topics.title: Why change is hard
topics.scope: Behavior-change mechanics: why habits fail, stages of change, small steps, patience, identity, effort vs violence, 'I know but don't do'.

topics.title: Tools and reflection practices
topics.scope: Concrete instruments: values definition, permissions wheel, wheel of balance, Plus/Minus/Next, year results and New Year reflection, learning how to learn.

topics.title: Coaching practice and client stories
topics.scope: Katya's health-coaching work: career change story, client goals and cases, testimonials.

topics.title: Dictionary of change: paired concepts (Словарь изменений)
topics.scope: Katya's rubric contrasting look-alike concepts that decide whether change sticks: control vs choice, self-compassion vs pity, pleasant vs necessary, faith vs expectations, refusal vs moderation, each with self-tests to tell them apart.

topics.title: Supplements: benefits and harms
topics.scope: Evidence review and cautionary tales: NMN, vitamin D, collagen, omega-3 stroke story, C60 hype, the 3-part 'how to harm yourself with vitamins' series.

topics.title: Gadgets and trackers
topics.scope: Wellness tech reviews and the nocebo effect: Lumen, Apple Watch, when trackers help vs harm, interoception, free health apps, wish-list products.

topics.title: Wellness independence and industry critique
topics.scope: Skills over tools: gadget consumerism, who profits from our beliefs, wellness trends as a shop window.

topics.title: Longevity and aging
topics.scope: Blue Zones, Bryan Johnson and Don't Die, KamaLama forecasts, genetics vs lifestyle, aging anxiety research.

topics.title: Women's health: cycle, pregnancy, check-ups
topics.scope: Menstrual cycle and energy, cycle biohacking, pregnancy and postpartum well-being (Marina's diary), lab tests and check-ups, cholesterol story, femtech.

topics.title: «На балансе с…» interview series
topics.scope: 30+ interviews with women about what balance means to them and how they balance careers, families, health and themselves; plus balance stories of Tim Ferriss guests etc.

topics.title: Recommendations: channels, podcasts, books, series
topics.scope: The 'whom to follow' rubric and other curated recommendations: telegram channels, podcasts, courses, series for women.

topics.title: Channel life and announcements
topics.scope: Channel meta: intro, milestones, navigation, rubricators, polls about formats, events and streams, ads, team changes, monthly recaps.
